pages.title: North East Nigeria
pages.description: geopolitical zone of Nigeria
pages.extract: North East Nigeria is a region of Nigeria that occupies slightly less than one-third of Nigeria's total area and had a projected population for 2023 of more than 30 million, or about one-eighth of the national total. The Fulani are the largest tribe across the region. The Kanuri make up the majority in Borno and Yobe states. The Jukun peoples are found in Taraba state and are also spread across neighbouring states. There are over 100 ethnic groups in the region.

pages.title: Owasso
pages.description: city in the Rogers and Tulsa counties, Oklahoma, United States
pages.extract: Owasso is a city of 39,000 people (2021) in the Green Country region of Oklahoma. Owasso sprang up around Tulsa International Airport, and is now largely a bedroom community of Tulsa.

pages.title: Rhine
pages.description: river in Western Europe to the North Sea
pages.extract: The Rhine River spans Central Europe and Western Europe. It flows through or along the borders of Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Austria, Germany, France and The Netherlands. It is a major navigation way and played an important role in history and culture of Europe.

pages.title: Minimum budget travel
pages.description: traveling at the lowest possible cost
pages.extract:
See budget travel for less radical advice, much of it relevant also on minimal budget.

Have you gone through the usual budget travel advice and still find yourself short of money? Minimum budget travel requires compromises on comfort, time management and predictability, in order to travel at no or very little cost, either as a necessity, a lifestyle, or a challenge.
